R01 aligned and staggered are two SYNTHETIC layouts of same values/series, not independent datasets with production HPA; broad node1d almost neutral, and R07 earlier 70k one-sample/14d broad1d/3d SQL vs native was slower. No unconditional query planner or index promotion.

Native avg uses compensated/vectorized TimeSeries path; cannot claim missing vectorization, or that processor work_us is exclusive CPU. Although tracked query memory is lower in R01, process RSS under allocator retention stays broadly unchanged.

Query form only finite gauges avg_over_time -> avg by(project/namespace), with each measured native call one evaluation point. 18 grid parities are three separate native evaluations, not one multi-step native call. No NaN-other, repeated same timestamp across batches, histogram, rate/reset, ACL, complex matcher or 1/4/8 multi-client tests.

No independent production-like 14d ingestion and concurrent 1/4/8 queries with O2/jemalloc allocation. Broad node1d only neutral in both R01 layouts; earlier one-point/14d showed different outcome, so need conditional admission.

Operator-profile elapsed_us cannot establish exclusive CPU root cause; representative native AdaptiveBucketMergingSource/ExpressionTransform and SQL ArrayJoin/Aggregating need matched CPU-stack, release O2, and allocator controls.
